newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ichikoh to start mass producing new LCDs early '98.
newsitem.headline: Ichikoh to start mass producing new LCDs early '98.

text.p: Ichikoh Industries Ltd said on Thursday it was aiming to start mass-production of new liquid crystal displays (LCD) in the first half of 1998.
"We are aiming to start mass production of the new LCDs in the first half of 1998," an Ichikoh official told Reuters.

The new LCDs can be produced at a lower cost than the conventional type because of technology called the dynamic-excite-drive (DED) system which enables LCDs to function without colour filters, Ichikoh said in a statement.
Earlier on Thursday, Alps Electric Co Ltd said that it, Ichikoh, Tohoku University and an unlisted company had jointly developed technology that cuts the cost of producing LCDs.
The news boosted the shares of Alps and Ichikoh on the Tokyo bourse. Ichikoh ended the Thursday session up 80 yen at 503 yen, while Alps rose by 50 yen to end at 1,750 yen.
